gloss: taking a commemorative photo; group photo

definitions.gloss: taking a commemorative photo; group photo
definitions.explanation: Taking a photograph to remember an occasion, such as a graduation, a wedding or a trip, typically of a group posing together.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{記念撮影|きねんさつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take a group photo together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{記念撮影|きねんさつえい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After the graduation ceremony, we had our picture taken in front of the school gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{記念撮影|きねんさつえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔出|かおだ}し⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Tourist spots often have face-in-the-hole boards for souvenir photos.

notes:
A fixed part of Japanese ceremonies and trips: the class photo at a school entrance ceremony, the group photo on a company trip. Casually people just say ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記念撮影|きねんさつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a commemorative photo
- ⟦{集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}→集合写真：31920_shuugoushashin⟧: a group photo (the resulting picture)
- {記念撮影|きねんさつえい}⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: a photo spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: filming, photographing, the general word
- ⟦{記念写真|きねんしゃしん}→記念写真：23222_kinenshashin⟧: a commemorative photo (the picture itself)
